description: Sums three attenuverted control voltages into one

params.text: Attenuverts its input from -100% to 100% before the sum; with that input unpatched it becomes an offset of -10V to 10V

inputs.text: One of the three signals summed into the output; with nothing patched it counts as a fixed 10V

outputs.text: The three attenuverted signals added together

notes: a preset called Unity mix ships with the module and sets all three attenuverters to 100%; it is in the Preset submenu of the right-click menu
